# Apache Spark — Technical Systems & Software Engineering Company
> Software, full-stack platforms, and distributed systems, drafted to spec and deployed end to end.

## Overview
Apache Spark is an elite software engineering and systems architecture firm based in San Francisco and Chicago. We engineer mission-critical applications, distributed cloud services, and low-latency systems for startups, venture-backed companies, and enterprise facilities.

## Principal Engineering Team
- Brandanlee Hugos: Lead Systems Developer & Co-Founder (Core Architecture, Distributed Consensus & High-Concurrency Systems)
- Dante Nicolas: Core Systems Engineer & Co-Founder (Low-Latency Pipelines, Network Protocols & Runtime Optimization)

## Core Capabilities
- Full-Stack Web & SaaS Platforms: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript Strict, Supabase, Postgres RLS, Tailwind CSS.
- Distributed Systems & High-Throughput APIs: Rust (Tokio), Go, gRPC, Kafka event streaming, sub-20ms p99 response times.
- Cloud & Infrastructure Mesh: Terraform IaC, Docker, Kubernetes, Zero-Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Vercel Edge caching.
- Industrial Telemetry & SCADA: Modbus, OPC-UA, industrial real-time Ethernet, cryogenic compute pods, Fluke DSX-8000 certified.

## Key Verified Deployments & Case Studies
- Project LiTrack (Department of Education): ARAL Diagnostic Reading Telemetry tracking 12,000+ active learner records with <18ms real-time diagnostic evaluation.
- Vanguard Foundry: SCADA Industrial Ethernet mesh with 99.999% uptime across harsh foundry environments.
- ASPAJCCJSI Press Portal: Multi-tenant high-velocity journalism publishing CMS with instant edge distribution.
- Metro Health Telemetry: High-resilience optical fiber telemetry rings for clinical monitoring.

## Commercial Engagements

- Full Turnkey Implementation (8–12 Weeks / 4–9 Months): Complete delivery from code to deployment pipeline with 100% IP transfer.
